content: Let $d$ denote a document containing sentences $[sent_1, sent_2, \cdots , sent_m]$, where $sent_i$ is the $i$-th sentence in the document. Extractive summarization can be defined as the task of assigning a label $y_i \in \lbrace 0, 1\rbrace $ to each $sent_i$, indicating whether the sentence should be included in the summary. It is assumed that summary sentences represent the most important content of the document.
